name: Question 6
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14144324/assets/af70455b167391a2fec7d0169f578c26079efcd002c2bea501b9460bc0c124f0.png)

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of a right-opening parabola is the left-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14144324/assets/41347b34b0680bdfcab2d1e002c6c41580eaef0b05901d4fc69ab508f786d1b5.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(0,0).$

Question 6
?

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?

a
(0,0)
b
(4,−4)
c
(0,−4)
d
(4,4)
e
(4,0)
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The vertex of a right-opening parabola is the left-most point of the parabola.

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are (0,0).
